Truly life changing.

I have suffered from debilitating Chronic Pain for over five years due to an injury from working on Oil Rigs that ended my labor career and basically my life.

I had visited many doctors in Chiang Mai during those five years across many different disciplines. Basically I had tried everything with no results. But literally after my first session with Dr. Noon I felt a change.

She used the Y-strap technique to adjust my neck and 80% of my pain disappeared over night. I continued treatment for a few months and am down to about 5% of my original pain level now, after 6 months without any further treatment.

I have even be able to return to pursuing and achieving my goal of becoming a diving instructor. Thank you again to Dr. Noon and the Nawapohn clinic, you truly changed my life.

Also their receptionist, Bank, had met me while he was working at a previous clinic years ago and he remembered me and my problem when I started at Nawapohn. He is also a very friendly and helpful guy.

I just went in for a follow up while visiting Chiang Mai this week and they remembered me and were very sweet.

The quality of English is also very good at the clinic and the doctor has even been able to get into deeper conversations with me about specific muscles and nerves that affected my issue.

I definitely recommend this clinic for you. A full 10 out of 10.
